representation_plans.encoded_information: The starting quantity, a supplied conversion fraction, crossed-out matching units, and the requested surviving unit.
representation_plans.decisive_feature: The same unit appears in opposite positions and therefore cancels.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Choose the orientation of the supplied factor that cancels the starting unit, then read the surviving unit.
representation_plans.why_better_than_prose: It makes the unit-level reason for the conversion visible beside the number calculation.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Use a text label and a noncolor strike-through marker for the matched units; do not pre-highlight an answer choice.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: None required; the learner can inspect or keyboard-navigate a static equation.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Read the starting quantity, then the numerator and denominator of the supplied factor; explicitly state which repeated unit cancels and which unit remains.
representation_plans.construct_preservation_judgment: The ordered text ledger preserves the required operation: factor orientation and unit cancellation.
representation_plans.static_or_reduced_motion_fallback: Static labeled equation; no motion communicates meaning.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Stack the starting quantity, factor, and result vertically while keeping each numerator directly above its denominator.

representation_plans.encoded_information: A rough-scale estimate alongside a computed value and marked meaningful digits.
representation_plans.decisive_feature: The final marked digit is justified by the least precise provided measurement.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Estimate the order of magnitude, compute the candidate result, and round the result to the supported number of significant digits.
representation_plans.why_better_than_prose: It separates magnitude checking from precision reporting without conflating the two operations.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Use labels for estimate, computed value, and reported value; digit markers are textual as well as visual.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: None required; a static comparison supports the calculation decision.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State the rough estimate, the unrounded calculation, the number of significant digits in each input, and the resulting reported value in order.
representation_plans.construct_preservation_judgment: The text sequence preserves estimation and precision selection without relying on position or color.
representation_plans.static_or_reduced_motion_fallback: Static three-line scale-and-digits comparison; no animation is used.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Show the estimate, calculation, and report as three labeled vertical rows.

representation_plans.encoded_information: A labeled part, whole, fraction, decimal, percentage, expected-count calculation, and square-root bracketing row.
representation_plans.decisive_feature: The same labeled part-to-whole relationship remains fixed while its numerical form changes.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Identify the part and whole, construct the relationship, then convert only into the form requested.
representation_plans.why_better_than_prose: It makes denominator choice and equivalent forms inspectable without hiding the reference group.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Repeat text labels for part and whole in every row; use no color-only distinction.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: A static table supports the target calculation; no drag interaction is necessary.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State the part, state the whole, read the fraction, then state the equivalent decimal or percent; for expected count, state probability per trial multiplied by the number of trials; for roots, state the two bounding squares.
representation_plans.construct_preservation_judgment: The linear text version retains the relation-identification operation and does not supply a scored response.
representation_plans.static_or_reduced_motion_fallback: Static labeled table with explicit row and column headers.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Convert each row into a labeled card; do not require horizontal scrolling.

representation_plans.encoded_information: Separate coefficient and exponent columns, the applied exponent operation, decimal-shift normalization, and final notation.
representation_plans.decisive_feature: The coefficient remains in the normalized interval while the exponent accounts for the scale.
representation_plans.learner_operation: Operate on coefficients and exponents separately, then move the decimal only with a compensating exponent adjustment.
representation_plans.why_better_than_prose: It prevents the common error of treating the entire notation string as one undifferentiated number.
representation_plans.signaling_plan: Use explicit column headers and written operation symbols; do not use color as the only distinction.
representation_plans.interaction_warrant: None required; a static equation ledger supports the target calculation.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State coefficient operation, state exponent operation, state any normalization decimal move, then state the normalized expression.
representation_plans.construct_preservation_judgment: The ordered text retains the required exponent-rule and normalization decisions.
representation_plans.static_or_reduced_motion_fallback: Static two-column ledger; no animation is used.
representation_plans.small_screen_behavior: Stack coefficient and exponent steps with their labels rather than compressing them into a wide table.

progressive_disclosure_rules: One primary cognitive job and at most one primary learner action per screen.
Optional derivations and glossary detail remain collapsed and never hide required teaching.
Feedback is unavailable until the learner commits a response.
A repair screen names the next operation and returns to the exact failed function on a fresh family.

learner_projection_excludes: hashes, gate status, route metadata, and reviewer controls

responsive_acceptance.content_plan: All primary tasks use single-column reflow, text labels, and a 320 px critical-fit design requirement.

content_plan: Keyboard order and focus destinations are declared for every screen.
Every quantitative representation has a construct-preserving text/nonvisual equivalent.
No meaning depends only on color, hover, sound, position, or motion.
Static fallbacks are specified; no animation is required for the construct.

required_checks: visible focus and feedback focus movement
no learner exposure of protected metadata
